dedupe_keys.name: dswe data science for wind energy

description: DSWE is an R package of statistical methods for wind-energy applications. The Texas A&M repository provides installation guidance and points to a tutorial and CRAN binaries. Analysts supply turbine performance, wind or operational measurements and run the supported data-science routines; outputs are fitted relationships and diagnostics for the selected wind farm. Geographic coverage follows the turbines and weather data in the input. The package DESCRIPTION states MIT licensing with a copyright file. A limitation is that empirical relationships may not transfer between turbines, controls or terrain without rechecking training conditions. Installation from source needs a C++ compiler, as the README notes. DSWE can analyse wind-farm operation and prepare performance assumptions for electricity planning simulations. The related catalogue ERA5 reanalysis provides weather context, not turbine-level statistical modelling. No turbine SCADA data or R package was downloaded.
